request.purpose: Compute the literal original x-to-q observable chain and test its conditional schedule consequences; not a fit and not evidence of physical support.
request.model_spec: Use xdot=alpha*r-x/tau for all times. Before arrest, qdot=kn*max(x-xc,0)-kd*q. At the first upward crossing x>=xc, permanently set qdot=0 (freeze q; no post-arrest loss). t h, r h^-1, x and q dimensionless. Grid alpha=.5,1,2; tau=1,5,20 h; illustrative kn=.1 h^-1 and kd=0,.1 h^-1. Schedules: fast r=.2 for 5 h, slow r=.05 for 20 h, both integral 1; r=0 after stop while x relaxes. Initial x0=0 and q0=0, .0148724491091024 (A t=0 proxy), .0138090880510916 (B t=0 proxy). Report all common ages 0,4,5,8,12,20,24,36,48 h, crossing time, x/q at crossing and close before/after, q at shutoff, post-cross growth/freeze, threshold-neighborhood initial x=xc-1e-6,xc,xc+1e-6, equality convention, no-cross regime alpha*r*tau<=xc from below, boundedness, units, numerical tolerances/convergence. Compare direction to public A/B 0-24 means without fit. Keep output compact by reporting these ages only. DATA is not required beyond the measurement means repeated below in code.
